method_card.title: Future Plans and Career Aspirations
method_card.content:
This lesson covers post-16 pathways and career aspirations using three future structures: me gustaría / querría (conditional), voy a + infinitive (near future) and the simple future tense (futuro simple).

SpanishEnglish
el bachilleratoA-levels / sixth form (Spain)
la formación profesional (FP)vocational training / BTEC / apprenticeship
la universidaduniversity
el año sabáticogap year
voy a + infinitiveI am going to
estudiaréI will study (simple future)
me gustaría + infinitiveI would like to (conditional)
querría + infinitiveI would like to (Higher conditional)
seréI will be (future of ser)
haréI will do (future of hacer)
iréI will go (future of ir)
en el futuroin the future
después del institutoafter school / sixth form
viajarto travel

Grammar focus — three future structures: (1) Near future: voy a + infinitive (I am going to). The verb ir is conjugated; the main verb stays as infinitive. (2) Simple future: infinitive + -é/-ás/-á/-emos/-éis/-án. Irregular stems to know: tendr- (tener), har- (hacer), pondr- (poner), vendr- (venir), querr- (querer). (3) Conditional: me gustaría / querría + infinitive (I would like to). Spanish post-16 paths: bachillerato = academic sixth form (like A-levels); formación profesional (FP) = vocational route (like BTECs or apprenticeships); universidad = university.

Model paragraph: Después del instituto voy a hacer el bachillerato porque quiero ir a la universidad. Estudiaré medicina y me gustaría ser médico. En el futuro viviré en una ciudad grande y tendré un trabajo bien pagado.
(After school I am going to do A-levels because I want to go to university. I will study medicine and I would like to be a doctor. In the future I will live in a big city and I will have a well-paid job.)
steps: Learn the post-16 pathway vocabulary: bachillerato, formación profesional, universidad
Use voy a + infinitive for immediate plans — the near future
Form the simple future: infinitive + -é/-ás/-á and know the irregular stems (tendr-, har-, seré, iré)
Use me gustaría / querría + infinitive for ambitions and wishes

exam_context.frequency: Core topic — future plans and post-16 pathways tested every year

worked_examples.question: Translate: Voy a hacer el bachillerato porque quiero ir a la universidad.

steps.label: Step 1
steps.content: Voy a hacer = I am going to do. Near future: ir (conjugated: voy) + a + infinitive (hacer).

steps.label: Step 2
steps.content: el bachillerato = A-levels / sixth form. porque quiero ir a la universidad = because I want to go to university.

steps.label: Answer
steps.content: I am going to do A-levels because I want to go to university.

worked_examples.question: Form the simple future: What is 'I will study' (estudiar)?

steps.label: Answer
steps.content: estudiaré (I will study). Note: regular -ar/-er/-ir verbs all use the full infinitive as the stem.

worked_examples.question: Translate into Spanish: 'After school I am going to do vocational training. I will work as an engineer and I would like to earn a high salary.'

steps.label: Step 1
steps.content: Near future: voy a hacer la formación profesional. FP = vocational training. Near future = voy a + infinitive.

steps.label: Step 2
steps.content: Simple future: trabajaré de ingeniero — note ser/trabajar de + profession: no article. Trabajaré = infinitive trabajar + é.

steps.label: Step 3
steps.content: Conditional wish: me gustaría ganar un sueldo alto. Me gustaría + infinitive. Un sueldo alto (masculine: sueldo is masculine).

steps.label: Answer
steps.content: Después del instituto voy a hacer la formación profesional. Trabajaré de ingeniero y me gustaría ganar un sueldo alto.

bronze.question: Match the Spanish post-16 pathway phrases to their English meaning
Match the Spanish future tense forms to their English meaning
Complete the sentence
sentence_parts: a hacer el bachillerato porque quiero

gaps.correct_explain: voy a = I am going to. Near future: ir (conjugated: voy) + a + infinitive.

wrong.ir: ir is the infinitive. You need the conjugated form → voy.
wrong.va: va is the él/ella form. The subject is 'I' → voy.

gaps.correct_explain: ir is the infinitive. After quiero (I want), use the infinitive.

wrong.voy: voy is conjugated. After quiero, use the infinitive → ir.
wrong.iré: iré is the simple future. After quiero, use the infinitive → ir.

bronze.question: Complete the sentence
sentence_parts: medicina en la universidad porque quiero ser

gaps.correct_explain: estudiaré = I will study. Simple future: infinitive estudiar + ending -é.

wrong.estudio: estudio is present tense. 'In the future' signals future tense → estudiaré.
wrong.voy a estudiar: Valid but the exercise tests the simple future form estudiaré.

gaps.correct_explain: médico (or another profession) — after quiero ser, no article before the profession.

wrong.un médico: After ser, omit the indefinite article → ser médico, not ser un médico.

bronze.question: What does 'Voy a hacer la formación profesional' mean?
options: I am going to do vocational training
I am going to do A-levels
I am going to go to university
I went to do vocational training

bronze.question: Which is the correct simple future form of 'trabajar' (yo)?

bronze.source_text: Cuando termine el instituto, voy a hacer la formación profesional. Me gustaría ser electricista.
model_answers: When I finish school, I am going to do vocational training. I would like to be an electrician.

bronze.question: Listen and type what you hear
bronze.audio_text: Voy a ir a la universidad el año que viene.
bronze.correct_text: Voy a ir a la universidad el año que viene.
bronze.translation: I am going to go to university next year.

silver.question: Complete the sentence

gaps.correct_explain: estudiaré = I will study. Simple future: infinitive + -é.

wrong.estudio: estudio is present tense. 'When I finish school' is future → estudiaré.
wrong.estudié: estudié is preterite (I studied — past). For future plans, use estudiaré.

gaps.correct_explain: médico (or another profession) — no article after ser before an unmodified profession.

silver.english: When I finish school, I will study medicine because I want to be a doctor.

silver.question: Find and fix the grammatical error
silver.sentence: En el futuro me gustaría tener un trabajo bueno y viviré en España.
silver.explanation: After me gustaría, use the infinitive, not the simple future. Correct: me gustaría tener un trabajo bueno y vivir en España. Alternatively, a new clause with a future or conditional is fine: ... y viviría en España (conditional).
silver.translation: In the future I would like to have a good job and live in Spain.

silver.question: Build the sentence in Spanish
silver.english: After school I am going to continue with my education.

distractor_labels.continuaré: this is the simple future — valid but the near future (voy a continuar) is being tested here

silver.source_text: After school I want to do A-levels. Then I will go to university and study law because I would like to be a lawyer.
model_answers: Después del instituto quiero hacer el bachillerato. Luego iré a la universidad y estudiaré derecho porque me gustaría ser abogado.

silver.question: Listen and type what you hear
silver.audio_text: Cuando termine el instituto, quiero hacer el bachillerato y después iré a la universidad.
silver.correct_text: Cuando termine el instituto, quiero hacer el bachillerato y después iré a la universidad.
silver.translation: When I finish school, I want to do A-levels and then I will go to university.

silver.question: Put these words in the correct order to form a sentence

gold.source_text: After school I am going to do A-levels because I want to go to university. I will study engineering and I would like to work abroad. In the future I will earn a good salary and I will travel a lot.
model_answers: Después del instituto voy a hacer el bachillerato porque quiero ir a la universidad. Estudiaré ingeniería y me gustaría trabajar en el extranjero. En el futuro ganaré un buen sueldo y viajaré mucho.

Accept any grammatically correct translation that conveys the same meaning. gold.question: Build the sentence in Spanish
gold.english: In the future I would like to work because I want to earn money and be independent.

distractor_labels.trabajo: wrong form — after me gustaría, use the infinitive trabajar, not conjugated trabajo
distractor_labels.gano: wrong form — after quiero, use the infinitive ganar, not conjugated gano
distractor_labels.me gusta: wrong tense — me gusta is present (I like). The English says 'I would like' → me gustaría

gold.question: Role Play
gold.scenario: You are speaking to a careers adviser at a tourist information office in Spain. They ask about your future study and career plans.

bullets.prompt: Say what you are going to do after school and why.
bullets.model_answer: Después del instituto voy a hacer el bachillerato porque quiero ir a la universidad.
bullets.note: near future: voy a + infinitive; quiero + infinitive

bullets.prompt: Say what you will study at university and what career you would like.
bullets.model_answer: Estudiaré medicina en la universidad. Me gustaría ser médico porque quiero ayudar a la gente.
bullets.note: simple future (estudiaré) + conditional (me gustaría ser) + ser + profession — NO article

bullets.prompt: Describe what your life will be like in the future — where you will live and what you will have.
bullets.model_answer: En el futuro viviré en una ciudad grande y tendré un buen trabajo. Ganaré un sueldo alto.
bullets.note: three simple future forms: viviré (regular), tendré (irregular stem tendr-), ganaré (regular)

bullets.prompt: Ask the careers adviser what qualifications you need for your chosen career.
bullets.note: ¿Qué titulaciones...? — question word with accent; necesito (present) + ser + profession (no article)

gold.ai_system_prompt: You are a GCSE Spanish examiner marking a role play about future plans and careers, set at a tourist information office. For each bullet, assess: (1) Did they communicate the required information? (2) Is the Spanish grammatically accurate? Check: near future (voy a + infinitive), simple future tense endings (-é/-ás/-á), irregular future stems (tendr-, har-, vendr-), me gustaría + infinitive (conditional), ser + profession with NO article, question word accent in ¿qué titulaciones? Award marks out of 10 total. Be encouraging. Respond in JSON: {"quality":"excellent|good|needs_work|not_valid","feedback":"Per-bullet feedback","improvement":"Key grammar point to revise"}

gold.question: Write 40-50 words in Spanish about your future plans. Include: what you are going to do after school, what you will study and why, what career you would like and a description of your life in the future.
gold.ai_system_prompt: You are a GCSE Spanish examiner marking extended writing about future plans. Mark on: Communication (post-16 path, subject of study, career wish, life description — all addressed?), Range of language (variety of future structures — near future voy a, simple future -é, conditional me gustaría/querría — plus connectives and opinion phrases), Accuracy (near future: voy a + infinitive; simple future endings; irregular stems tendr-/har-/seré/iré; ser + profession no article; no confusion between future and present). Be encouraging and formative. Respond in JSON: {"quality":"excellent|good|needs_work|not_valid","feedback":"3-4 sentences covering each criterion","improvement":"One specific grammar point to work on"}

gold.question: Listen and type what you hear
gold.audio_text: Después del instituto voy a hacer el bachillerato. Estudiaré medicina en la universidad porque quiero ser médico.
gold.correct_text: Después del instituto voy a hacer el bachillerato. Estudiaré medicina en la universidad porque quiero ser médico.
gold.translation: After school I am going to do A-levels. I will study medicine at university because I want to be a doctor.

gold.source_text: In the future I would like to have a good job. If I had the opportunity, I would live in Spain and work as a doctor.
model_answers: En el futuro me gustaría tener un buen trabajo. Si tuviera la oportunidad, viviría en España y trabajaría de médico.
